description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for monitoring and handling cookie change events within the Chromium networking code. It includes enums for change causes, a struct for change info, callback types, and classes for subscribing to cookie change notifications.

classes.name: CookieChangeSubscription
classes.description: Represents a subscription to cookie change events, manages listener interest lifecycle.

classes.name: CookieChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for components that observe and subscribe to cookie change events, allowing registration for specific cookie or URL changes or all changes.

methods.name: AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to specific cookies identified by URL and name, with optional partition key.

methods.name: AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to cookies associated with a specific URL, with optional partition key.

methods.name: AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Registers a callback to observe all cookie store changes.
